summary: For the exact-rank-three Hadamard target family A=U diag(1,1,-1) U^T, the new local 3-coordinate coarea cost K(A_I) has determinant-weighted average at least (3^(7/4)/4)n over the invertible three-distinct-type triples. Thus applying reciprocal-curvature physical-triple bounds first and averaging their scalar constants afterward with Cauchy-Binet/Pluecker determinant weights is not dimension-free. This does not refute QFORM or the local coarea theorem; product/determinant aggregation must occur before the local scalar collapse.
